column1: # note: The 2025 Nebraska Tax Calculation Schedule for Form 1040N line 15. Form 1040N says paper filers may use the Nebraska Tax Table and all others must use this schedule.
# note: The married filing jointly and qualifying surviving spouse schedule is repeated for both statuses.
# note: The schedule's first row reads "2.46% of Nebraska Taxable Income"; it is written as a base tax of zero over $0.
# note: The booklet has all amounts entered as whole dollars, rounding 50 cents or more up, so line 15 is the schedule's tax rounded to the dollar.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
